subject: PR next steps: Coupa/Ariba supplier linkage & PO vs card for Acme Health
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Anna Durant <anna.durant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + PR/PO path — Acme Health

Hi Anna — great to meet today, thanks for the productive conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement team has what they need to create a Purchase Requisition (PR):

Key notes from our call:
- Acme prefers PO-based procurement on Net-30 for enterprise contracts.
- Coupa is the procurement system you usually use; Ariba occasionally for certain regions.
- Pilot can run on a credit card if procurement needs more time, but enterprise will be PO.

Next steps I can help with:
1) Share a PR template with the exact line-item wording, GL code suggestions, and suggested quantities so your team can paste into Coupa/Ariba. (Attached: redwood_pr_template.xlsx)
2) Provide Redwood vendor fields needed for supplier creation (DUNS, legal name, remit-to, contact, tax docs). (Attached: redwood_vendor_info_stub.pdf and W-9)
3) Confirm whether you want to route the purchase via AWS Marketplace (faster onboarding) or direct vendor PO. I can get the Marketplace listing link and SKU if desired.

If you can confirm the primary procurement contact and whether we should supply a Coupa punchout or just a supplier record, I’ll follow up with Sales Ops to provide the exact supplier ID and any paperwork.

Suggested ask to your procurement team when they create the PR:
- Line item: Redwood Inference — Hosted Inference (monthly committed/usage)
- Unit: 1 subscription (description: monthly committed GPU inference capacity)
- Price: TBD (we will attach a quote once we have the PR number)
- PO approval due date: please share the PR/requisition ID back to invoices@redwood.com and to me so we can match it to the quote.

Thanks — I’ve looped Laura (sales ops) and Monica (customer success) for supplier onboarding and SOW handoff.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
redwood_inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Anna Durant <anna.durant@acmehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + PR/PO path — Acme Health

Thanks Nikhil — couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- We will 95% do a PO (Net-30) for production; pilot would likely be on card if we can keep it under $5k.
- For Coupa we need the vendor legal name, DUNS, remit address, TAX ID, and the primary AP contact. Do you have a Redwood supplier ID already in our Coupa instance? If not, we will create one but need the exact fields.
- Also please confirm whether Redwood is available via AWS Marketplace (if yes, using Marketplace contract can speed things up and we often use card-to-PO conversion there).

I attached our procurement questionnaire — can you and your team fill the vendor fields that map directly into Coupa (column A-H) and return? That will let us expedite the supplier creation.

Appreciate the PR template — I’ll circulate it internally and aim to get a requisition raised by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Anna Durant
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health
(Attachment: acme_procurement_questionnaire.docx)

Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
DUNS: 54-321-9876
Tax ID / EIN: 27-1234567
Remit-to address: 2104 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114
Primary AP contact: invoices@redwood.com

Coupa/Ariba notes:

- We do not yet have an existing supplier ID in Acme's Coupa instance (I checked), so one will be created when your team submits the questionnaire. If you need a Redwood internal vendor number for your records, use our internal cohort code: RW-ENT-2026.

Marketplace option:
- Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (link below). If you route the pilot via Marketplace we can often accept a card and convert to a PO later; for enterprise bookings we prefer direct PO so we can match committed capacity and custom SKUs.
https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/vendors/redwood-inference

PR creation guidance (copy/paste friendly):
- Item description: 1x Redwood Inference — Hosted Inference (monthly committed capacity)
- Catalog/GL code: 5-5200-30 (Software subscriptions)
- Qty: 1
- Unit price: see attached quote (to be provided once PR ID is shared)
- Requested start/term: enter desired start date and 12-month term (or pilot dates for card)

Attachments included: redwood_pr_template.xlsx, redwood_vendor_info_stub.pdf, w9_redwood.pdf

Please reply with the PR/requisition ID once created and I will attach the quote and route to Sales Ops for onboarding. Laura, can you start the vendor onboarding ticket once Anna shares the supplier creation confirmation?

Thanks,
Nikhil
